Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class AnalystNoteController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.AnalystNoteController
@Controller public class AnalystNoteController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller serving the analyst notes page at GET /notes.

Allows SUBSCRIBER, DEMO, and ADMIN users to create, edit, and delete private text notes attached to companies, articles, regulatory events, clinical trials, and wiki pages.

FREE and FREE_PENDING users are redirected to the pricing page.
